notes: # EEPROM Studio 1.0.4 — CH341A suspicious-dump warning (Experimental Beta) This signed 1.0.4 update adds safety warnings for CH341A read-only EEPROM dumps, without changing XP400 hardware operations. - Warns when CH341A produces an all-FF dump, an all-00 dump, or an unusually long FF prefix. - Offers **Keep flagged dump** or **Discard and reseat ad
